name: DriftKineticElectrostaticAdiabatic Cyclone (cupy)
description:
Cyclone-instability ITG turbulence case for DriftKineticElectrostaticAdiabatic (see
examples/DriftKineticElectrostaticAdiabatic/cyclone/params_cyclone.py, the physics case
this profiling params file is adapted from), used as the NumPy-vs-CuPy backend
comparison case for a real gyrokinetic model rather than a toy one.

custom_commands: echo "Running profiling case: driftkinetic_cyclone_cupy_scaling (1 MPI ranks)"

echo "Description: Cyclone-instability ITG turbulence case for DriftKineticElectrostaticAdiabatic, run with the CuPy array backend at increasing MPI rank counts (one GPU per rank) on a fixed grid/marker configuration, to measure strong-scaling speedup and verify the CUDA-ported kernels and MPI exchange paths work correctly for this model under multi-rank/multi-GPU. Uses params_cyclone.py's own default solver='direct' (feectools.linalg.solvers.DirectSolver) at every rank count, now that DirectSolver supports nprocs > 1 via a replicated global-matrix assembly."
echo "Physics problem: Electrostatic drift-kinetic ITG turbulence with adiabatic electrons in toroidal geometry."
echo "Completed profiling case: driftkinetic_cyclone_cupy_scaling (1 MPI ranks)"
